description:
FILED s419 (Fable) by the flip re-census (docs/drop-census-s419-flip-gate.md
family 9).  re/pat.t lines 758/767/804/818/831 all drop:

  is($#{^CAPTURE}, -1, $message);

`@{^CAPTURE}` is the 5.26+ named capture array; `$#{^CAPTURE}` is its last
index.  PCL handles `@{^CAPTURE}`? â VERIFY FIRST (the cheap discriminating
measurement): probe `"abc" =~ /(a)(b)/; print scalar @{^CAPTURE}, " ",
$#{^CAPTURE};` vs perl.  If the array itself works, the gap is only the
`$#{BLOCK}` spelling with a caret name inside (the $# last-index operator
over a block deref whose content is a caret variable); if the array is also
absent, this is the ^CAPTURE feature, a different (runtime) layer.
Blocks the announce->DIE flip.

DONE s420.  Both halves were real: `@{^CAPTURE}` had no runtime variable at
all (the emitter passed the name through BARE, and a bare all-caps token reads
DOWN-cased under :invert, so the file aborted unbound), and `$#{^CAPTURE}` —
the one spelling PPI hands over as Cast + Block — was dropped whole.
Shipped: the runtime array beside @-/@+ (set-capture-groups fills it with the
group VALUES, truncated after the last participating group, undef inside that
range); %{^CAPTURE} and %{^CAPTURE_ALL} map onto %+ and %- (perl SYNONYMS, so
no new state); _block_caret_name in PExpr collapses the Cast+Block spelling
(which also fixed the SPACED `$ {^XY}` form, t/base/lex.t); and both
ArrayIndex leaf emitters now share one container helper that consults
%SPECIAL_VARS.  re/pat.t 8 drops -> 3.  Guard: Pl/t/match-vars-01.t row 26.
Found on the way: #417 (@+ is sized by the pattern, @- by participation).
